about_the_game:
With a ferocious creature destroying entire dimensions without even trying, only the Dimensional Travelers are able to stand in it's way. Doller, a lazy apprentice Mage, is about to be sent on the adventure of a lifetime. Teaming up with the other Dimensional Travelers, Yeign; a Navish Warrior, Freia; a well mannered Demon Spawn, and Yosei; a Thief Pixie that will come at you if you call him a Fairy. Following the Commander's orders, can this misfit group really stop everything going on?

  • 5 World Maps 230 x 178 blocks large

  • Night and day cycles with the ability to break into buildings

  • Different endings for the Dimensional Beast

  • Powerful storylines and character arcs and each dimension has a different feel

  • Working PC in the Airship Cabin that has apps and fully working games 

  • NPCs working and doing tasks making each world feel alive

  • Original Sound Track by composer Anthony Fusilier

Being a solo dev project by a professional sci-fi/fantasy writer, Dimensional Gates is the next amazing adventure you're set to experience. With hours and hours of gameplay, storylines, and battling enemies, you can feel the heart and soul that was placed into the making of this game well. 

* Game designed using RPG Maker MV Engine (screen freeze issues fixed)

content_descriptors.notes: There is an option in the equip menu that is called "naked" that only removes all armor and weapons, but leaves an image of the character wearing underwear in pixel art form only.
